title: Jordan Love: The biggest difference this year is our ability to finish

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jordan Love: The biggest difference this year is our ability to finish
sources.description: The Packers' inability to hold onto a big lead in their playoff loss to the Bears is still on quarterback Jordan Love's mind as they get ready for the 2026 season.
